Minister Savannah Maziya said Eswatini already has the Computer Crime and Cybercrime Act as legal groundwork, with its regulations at an advanced stage.
ESCCOM's Assistant Director says the Computer Crime and Cybercrime Act of 2022 designated ESCCOM as national cybersecurity agency and gives it regulatory mandate under Section 52.
